scope: Halfworld props, set pieces and vehicles. Transitive static imports indicate availability, not necessarily visible use.

artifacts.name: Aegis
artifacts.owners: athena · never carried, lent or set down by any mortal in the house; held from the roof of the megaron and taken back up with her

artifacts.name: Antinous's Cup and Feast Table
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · hall furniture and plate of the megaron, set out nightly for the suitors; this board and this two-eared gold cup are in Antinous's use at the moment of the first shot, and revert to the house

params.material: ash poles, ox-hide lashing, terracotta, beaten iron, sea sponge

owners.detail: telemachus, eumaeus, philoetius, the serving women
owners.material: ash poles, ox-hide lashing, terracotta, beaten iron, sea sponge

artifacts.name: Bow-heating Fire and Tallow
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · kitchen brazier and store tallow, fetched and worked by Melanthius the goatherd for the suitors; never Odysseus's, and gone from the hall before the true stringing

owners.steward: the handmaids (carried up to the chamber)

artifacts.name: Courtyard Execution Cable
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · a hawser off one of Odysseus's dark-prowed ships, carried up from the shore store. Rigged across the outer court by Telemachus, who makes it fast to a pillar of the colonnade and throws the far part over the round-house, setting it high so that no foot can reach the ground

artifacts.name: Courtyard Gate and Cable
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · the outer court gate of the well-fenced yard; shut and barred from within by Philoetius, who lashes it with a papyrus ship's hawser found lying under the colonnade

artifacts.name: Defender Armor Set
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · fetched from the storeroom by Telemachus · issued one set each to Odysseus, Telemachus, Eumaeus, Philoetius

params.material: goatskin, stitched ox-hide, coarse worn linen, olive-wood haft, beaten iron, withy

owners.detail: kept and mended by the old Sicilian woman on the farm
owners.material: goatskin, stitched ox-hide, coarse worn linen, olive-wood haft, beaten iron, withy

artifacts.name: Ox Hoof
artifacts.owners: megaron-hall · feast board (seized and thrown by Ctesippus)

artifacts.name: Palace Weapon Collection
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · storeroom key held by Eurycleia; route known to Melanthius

artifacts.name: Storeroom Rope and Rafter
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · the arms-store off the megaron: a made-up cord and the tie beam above it. Rove and worked by Eumaeus and Philoetius on Odysseus's order to hoist the bound Melanthius up the pillar until he hangs close under the roof beams

artifacts.name: Twelve Axe Heads
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · dug and set by Telemachus; carried in by two maids from the storeroom chest; the twelve are counted, never divided

artifacts.name: Women's Chamber Doors
artifacts.owners: house-of-odysseus · the women's quarters; the bar and strap are Eurycleia's, shot on Telemachus' order in Book XXI and drawn again in Book XXII
